jobs.name: ghstore-reconcile
jobs.prompt:
Run the GitHub-first state reconcile and report the result.

Execute this exact command:

    sh /data/.hermes/ghfirst/reconcile.sh

It pushes any Hermes state changes to the GitHub repository, verifies the committed tree, and reports drift plus /data disk pressure. The credential is read from /data/.hermes/.env automatically — never print, echo, or reveal its contents or any token value.

Reply with a SHORT plain-text status (a few lines maximum):
- the commit sha pushed, or 'no changes — repo in sync'
- whether verify passed (only claim this if the output literally said VERIFY OK)
- drift counts (local-only / remote-only / differing)
- the /data disk line it printed
- if anything failed: the exact error and the exit code

Never claim success unless the command's own output said VERIFY OK.
